data.notes: Search budget (20) exhausted. Pre-2005 generations listed only where sold in 2005 (S80 I, V70 II, XC70 I). S90 I/V90 I (1997-98) out of range. Facelifts of S80 II, V70 III, XC70 II not split (no evidence of changed volume). S90/V90/V90 CC facelift split because dimensions and published trunk values changed. ADAC folded values for older cars are partly "fensterhoch" vs "dachhoch".

corrections.evidence: AutoScout24 tech data S90 T8 Twin Engine AWD Geartronic (seit 2017, Limousine): Kofferraumvolumen 500 l; vision-mobility.de S90 T8 Twin-Engine also 500 l; an ADAC S90 T8 Twin Engine Polestar Performance R Design (2019) entry was reported in search snippets with 500 l normal. Volvo US spec gives identical cargo volume for T5/T6/T8. The 436 l figure belongs to the long-wheelbase S90L (China), not the German S90. Medium confidence (ADAC page not opened directly).
ADAC S90 B5 Diesel Momentum Pro AWD Automatik (07/20-02/22): Länge 4969 mm, Kofferraumvolumen normal 453 l; identical for Inscription (313706). B5 Diesel is a 48V mild hybrid.
ADAC: S90 facelift mild-hybrid (B5 Diesel AWD) normal trunk 453 l (T8 PHEV 431 l). Base (non-PHEV) value is 453 l.

ams (03.09.2025): V90 production ends September 2025; new orders in Germany already no longer possible. Volvo DE site: V90 (Mild-Hybrid and Plug-in-Hybrid) no longer available as new car, production ended. angurten.de: B4/B4 Diesel mild hybrids dropped end of 2024 in Germany, only PHEVs remained into 2025. Last V90 built Oct 2025 (Wikipedia/motor1).

angurten.de: V90 Cross Country built until 12/2024; with the discontinuation of the V90 mild hybrids the Cross Country (never offered as PHEV) was dropped at the same time. Consistent with ADAC entries ending 12/24 and Volvo DE page stating the V90 Cross Country is no longer available, production ended.
cars-data.com lists 480 l luggage capacity for S80 (2007) T6 AWD, D5 AWD and V8 AWD, identical to FWD versions; length 4851, wheelbase 2835.

missing.detail: Facelift S90/V90 went on sale in Germany from 03/2020 (ADAC V90 B5 03/20, S90 B5 Diesel 06/20); yearFrom 2021 reflects MY2021 but German sales started 2020. Also ADAC lists V90 T6 AWD 03/20-09/21 under the facelift. Consider yearFrom 2020.
S90 facelift ADAC entries (e.g. B5 Diesel Ultimate Bright AWD 02/22-12/24) confirm yearTo 2024 for Germany; topgear.nl: European sales ended after MY2024.
